baseline_models.focus_anchor: ٱخْفِضْ لَهُمَا جَنَاحَ ٱلذُّلِّ مِنَ ٱلرَّحْمَةِ ... كَمَا رَبَّيَانِى صَغِيرًا
baseline_models.mechanism: The child nourished from smallness converts grown capacity into a lowered, sheltering side. The gentle-side branch of ذ ل ل keeps the reversal willing and tender rather than degrading.

activation_trace.role: Descent after elevation supplies the vertical reversal and makes adult capacity something voluntarily brought down.
Wing as side, hand, and shelter supplies the protective capacity lowered toward the parents.
A soft side without disgrace defines willing gentleness rather than humiliation.
Tenderness and beneficence provide the motive for lowering and the effect requested in prayer.
Nourishing growth supplies the parents' earlier action that the present lowering answers.
Smallness in age or stature fixes the remembered condition of dependence.

changed_reading.before: A general command to be humble and compassionate toward one's parents.
changed_reading.after: A grown child's acquired capacity is deliberately lowered into protective gentleness in answer to the parents' earlier work of raising a dependent child.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: وَقُل رَّبِّ ٱرْحَمْهُمَا كَمَا رَبَّيَانِى صَغِيرًا
baseline_models.mechanism: Reciprocity does not close inside the child-parent dyad. The verse moves from an act the child can perform to speech addressed to the Lord; repeated ر ح م joins human tenderness to requested divine mercy, while ر ب ب and ر ب و join lordship, completion, and nurture.

activation_trace.role: Voiced speech transfers the sequence from embodied conduct to explicit appeal.
Lordship identifies the addressee whose agency exceeds the child's own.
Repair, nurture, and completion make divine lordship able to complete unfinished filial care.
The same tenderness field links the child's motive to the mercy requested from the Lord.
Feeding and growth name the prior care whose adequate return is handed beyond the child.

changed_reading.before: The child asks God to reward the parents for past upbringing.
changed_reading.after: The child performs the care within reach, then entrusts its unpayable remainder to the Lord whose own action includes nurturing and completion.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding ayah supplies the other end of the lifespan: parents reach old age while the focus remembers the speaker's smallness. Exclusive worship prevents filial ذل from becoming worship, and the ban on harsh rebuke turns lowered gentleness into the mature child's assumption of a careful role once held by the parents.

activation_trace.role: Gentleness without abasement supplies a bounded filial lowering.
Childhood smallness supplies one pole of the life-stage reversal.
Submissive worship names the relation reserved by the exclusivity construction for God and bounds filial lowering.
Old age supplies the opposite pole to remembered smallness and marks changed capacity.
Harsh verbal expulsion supplies the blocked behavior against which the lowered wing operates.

structural_cues: 17:23 orders exclusive worship, beneficence to parents, restraint of contempt and rebuke, and noble speech immediately before the focus.
The parent at كِبَر and the speaker at صَغِيرًا occupy opposite ends of a care cycle.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exclusive worship, parental old age, prohibited rebuke, and remembered childhood smallness; I infer that changed strength calls for changed caregiving roles. Alternatively, the pairing may teach etiquette without a strict reciprocal life-cycle mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Lowering the wing is undifferentiated submission to parental rank.
changed_reading.after: It is a non-cultic transfer of caregiving responsibility: as parental capacity declines, the grown child answers earlier nurture with voluntarily softened power and protected speech.

context_deltas.mechanism: Ayat 26-30 distribute care across claims, resources, bodily availability, and speech. A due must be honored; when material help is unavailable, mercy persists as easy speech; the hand is neither chained nor totally extended; and provision alternates between expansion and restriction. The lowered wing is calibrated accessibility, not limitless self-erasure.

activation_trace.role: Wing as side, hand, and shelter gives mercy bodily, protective, and practical interfaces.
A binding due makes care answer to a real claim rather than remain optional sentiment.
Tender beneficence keeps temporary material refusal inside the focus's mercy field.
Ease after difficulty makes non-material speech a gentle bridge when giving cannot occur.
A collar binding the limb supplies the closed extreme of unavailable capacity.
Extending and releasing the hand supplies the opposite extreme of unbounded expenditure.
Restriction to a small measure normalizes finite capacity within the surrounding economy of care.

structural_cues: 17:28 commands gracious speech even while turning away and awaiting mercy.
17:29 opposes hand positions, and 17:30 repeats expansion beside restriction at the level of provision.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies rights, merciful speech under lack, bound and overextended hands, and variable provision; I infer that these are interfaces and limits for the focus's wing. Alternatively, the resource sequence may govern wider social beneficiaries without specifying filial care.

changed_reading.before: Lowering the wing requires unrestricted availability and self-sacrifice.
changed_reading.after: It requires reliable but measured accessibility: honoring claims, keeping speech gentle when resources fail, and refusing both clenched withholding and self-exhausting extension.

context_deltas.mechanism: Ayat 31 and 34 expose nurture under threat and by its absence: children must not be abandoned under scarcity, while a child cut off from a caretaker requires protected interests under an enduring covenant. The speaker's remembered upbringing becomes both testimony for preserving later dependents and a model of custodial fidelity across changing capacity.

activation_trace.role: Feeding and growth supply the life-preserving labor remembered by the adult child.
Smallness supplies the vulnerable stage shared by the speaker, later children, and the orphan.
Descendants born into the family extend care into the next generation.
A hand stripped of wealth supplies the scarcity threatening continued nurture.
Apportioned provision interrupts scarcity's claim to authorize abandonment.
A child cut off from a caretaker reveals the protective work hidden inside ordinary upbringing.
Preserving something state after state supplies durable custodial fidelity.

structural_cues: 17:31 joins threatened children to provision for both them and their caregivers.
17:34 protects the orphan's property until maturity and immediately commands fulfillment of the covenant.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies remembered nurture, scarcity-threatened children, orphaned lack of a caretaker, and covenant; I infer a relay from received care to stewardship of later vulnerability. Alternatively, these rules may remain adjacent duties rather than extensions of the focus.

changed_reading.before: Remembered upbringing grounds only a private backward debt to one's parents.
changed_reading.after: It witnesses to a broader custody ethic: mercy received in smallness is answered by preserving vulnerable life and interests through scarcity and changing capacity.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's downward wing, upward nurture, and remembered smallness form a vertical grammar that 17:37 tests against swaggering height. The walker cannot break the ground below or attain the mountains above; adult growth becomes capacity to incline toward aging parents rather than license for self-inflation.

activation_trace.role: Lowering after height supplies the deliberate downward motion countering self-elevation.
Former smallness punctures the fantasy that present stature is self-generated.
Joy exceeding its measure supplies the inflated bodily attitude opposed to the lowered wing.
Low ground opposite the sky fixes the lower boundary the proud walker cannot master.
The solid raised mass supplies the unattainable upper comparator for human height.
Vertical extension names the scale on which proud self-enlargement is denied.

structural_cues: 17:37 negates mastery in both directions: the walker neither breaks the earth below nor reaches mountain height.
The focus sequences lowering, nurture or growth, and remembered smallness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies downward command, growth, smallness, proud walking, earth, and mountain height; I infer that received growth must become care rather than self-elevation. Alternatively, 17:37 may condemn public swagger without specifically glossing filial posture.

changed_reading.before: The lowered wing is a private courtesy restricted to parents.
changed_reading.after: It is the local cure for an illusion of self-made height: grown strength remembers its dependent origin and bends toward care instead of superiority.

context_deltas.mechanism: The passage brackets filial lowering between exclusive worship before it and a closing ban on another deity. Inside that frame, the child lowers toward the parents but speaks to Rabb for mercy. The geometry distinguishes intense honor from deification and makes God the terminal source of mercy.

activation_trace.role: Lordship identifies the sole higher authority invoked to complete mercy.
Worshipful obedience supplies the category the preceding exclusivity syntax reserves for God.
Divine disclosure classifies the intervening ethic as received guidance rather than family custom.
Accurate wisdom supplies the frame holding intense filial care together with theological limits.
The worshipped object supplies the closing prohibited category into which parental honor must not cross.

structural_cues: The sole-worship construction in 17:23 precedes the parent command, while the prohibition of another deity in 17:39 closes the sequence.
Within the focus, bodily direction is toward the parents but direct address is to رَبِّ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies theological bookends, lowered filial posture, and prayer to Rabb; I infer that the frame separates maximal honor from worship and routes ultimate mercy through God. Alternatively, the bookends may govern the whole list without specifically delimiting the parent metaphor.

changed_reading.before: The ayah intensifies parental veneration without specifying its theological boundary.
changed_reading.after: It stages maximal filial tenderness inside exclusive worship: the body bends toward the parents, while final dependence and mercy remain directed to the Lord.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the ordinary clause foregrounds compassion, while packet branches reach into womb, kinship, and pain after birth; the dual parents blocks a maternal-only reading. It remains anchored in repeated ر ح م, nurture, and childhood smallness. Carry it only as a somatic echo of care's costs, not a replacement translation or exclusive referent.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: مِنَ ٱلرَّحْمَةِ ... ٱرْحَمْهُمَا كَمَا رَبَّيَانِى صَغِيرًا

activation_trace.role: Close kinship makes mercy remember a concrete bond rather than remain generalized affect.
The womb as the child's first containing house supplies a bodily prototype for the sheltering wing.
Pain following birth supplies a hidden bodily cost within remembered raising.
Feeding and growth extend birth's bodily beginning into sustained nurture.

changed_reading.before: Mercy is an abstract compassionate feeling prompted by gratitude.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, mercy carries bodily memory of kinship, containment, birth-cost, and feeding, so the lowered wing answers a history borne in bodies.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is cross-domain: 17:35 measures goods, while كَمَا does not state economic equivalence. It remains anchored in the comparison, remembered nurture, present mercy, and branches of completion and balancing. Render it as answerability across unlike media, never calculable debt.

activation_trace.role: Tender beneficence supplies the present medium placed in relation to past nurture.
Feeding and growth supply the earlier contribution that cannot be returned in the same form.
Completion without deficiency activates the question of faithful answering.
Balancing two things supplies relational measure without requiring identical contents.
The scale supplies the image by which unlike acts of care remain answerable to one another.

changed_reading.before: The comparison asks for mercy resembling the parents' earlier mercy.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it sets unlike acts on a nonfungible scale: nurture cannot be duplicated, but it can be answered by tenderness, protection, and prayer.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This depends on the packet's non-dominant ق و ل mapping to ق ل ل, so it is intentionally form-distant and must not replace the ordinary sense of قُل. It remains anchored at the speech form and in linked motions of lowering, growth, and smallness. Render it only as a secondary resonance in which prayer bears the parents' need upward.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: ٱخْفِضْ ... وَقُل رَّبِّ ... كَمَا رَبَّيَانِى صَغِيرًا

activation_trace.role: Lowering after elevation supplies the child's embodied downward motion.
Carrying and rising turn the petition into a counter-motion bearing the parents' need upward.
Their earlier nourishing growth supplies the upward work to which prayer responds.
Former smallness keeps the counter-lift attached to the speaker's dependent origin.

changed_reading.before: The spoken prayer reports gratitude after the bodily command.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, speech becomes reciprocal motion: the child lowers bodily while prayer carries the parents' need upward after they raised the child.

strongest_changes: The focus became a life-cycle reversal in which grown capacity is lowered into sheltering gentleness as parents move into old age.
Ayat 26-30 changed mercy from unlimited self-abasement into calibrated care across rights, resources, bodily availability, and speech.
The earth-and-mountain contrast made the lowered wing an answer to self-made height, while the theological bookends bounded honor as non-cultic.
summary.what_was_special: The focus roots already formed a geometry of lowering, shelter, soft compliance, nurture or growth, and smallness. Context supplied opposite life stages, bounded hands, vulnerable dependents, vertical limits, and exclusive worship, allowing distinct mechanisms without detaching from the focus.
remaining_uncertainties: The dependency-custody model is a coherent contextual extension but need not determine direct lexical sense.
The weighing analogy must not turn gratitude into arithmetic repayment.
The womb and postpartum echo and the non-dominant ق و ل to ق ل ل counter-lift are exploratory resonances, not translation claims.
